simple.summary: יָקָר (yâqâr) means valuable (objectively or subjectively) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 20 2.

definitions.usage: brightness, clear, costly, excellent, fat, honourable women, precious, reputation.
definitions.full: H3368. yaqar יָקָר adjective precious, rare, splendid, weighty ; — absolute יָקָר 1Sam 3:1 9 t.; construct יְקַרֿ Prov 17:27 Qr (Kt וקר ; see below); כִּיקַר Psa 37:20 ; feminine יְקָרָה 2Sam 12:30 14 t.; construct יִקְרַת Isa 28:16 ; masculine plural יְקָרִים Lam 4:2 ; feminine plural יְקָדוֺת 1 Kings 5:31 2 t. + Zech 14:6 (see below); יְקָרֹת 1Kin 7:9 ; suffix בְּיִקְּרוֺתֶ֑יךָ Psa 45:10 (so Baer; van d. H ׳בִּיקְּ ); — 1 precious: a. costly , יְקָרוֺת אֲבָנִים of costly building-stones 1 Kings 5:31; 1Kin 7:9-10 , 11 compare מוּסָּד מוּסָד יִקְרַת מִּנַּת Isa 28:16 a costly corner (-stone) of a foundation, — on construct see Da Synt. § 28, R. 3, 6 ; יָקָר הוֺן costly wealth Prov 1:13 ; 12:27 ; וְנָעִים יָקָר הוֺן 24:1 . b. precious, highly valued: יְקָרָה נֶפֶשׁ Prov 6:26 precious life ; opposed to זוֺלֵל Jer 15:19 (of choice elements of character); י בְּעֵינֵי ׳יָקָר לַחֲסִידָיו הַמָּֽוְתָה Psa 116:15 ; מפניים הִיא יְקָרָה Prov 3:15 she (wisdom) is more precious than rubies (see also c ); prized , of י ׳חסד Psa 36:8 ; = substantive בְּיִקְּרותֶ֑יךָ מְלָכִים בְּנוֺת 45:10 king's daughters are among thy precious ( = dear ) ones. c. יְקָרָה אֶבֶן collective precious stones, jewels 2Sam 12:30 = 1Chr 20:2 ; 1Kin 10:2 , 10 ; 1:11 2Chr 9:1 , 9 , 10 ; 1Chr 29:3 ; 2Chr 3:6 ; 32:27 ; Ezek 27:22 ; 28:13 (list of precious stones follows), Dan 11:38 ; so also Lam 4:2 , read הַיְקָרִים צִיּוֺן אַבְנֵי (for וגו ׳בְּנֵי ᵑ0 ), see VB; יָקָר שֹׁהַם Job 28:16 (see also Prov 3:15 below b ). 2 rare , 1Sam 3:1 (compare √ Hiph`il Isa 13:12 ). 3 glorious, splendid (compare Aramaic), of the moon Job 31:26 ; as substantive = glory , the wicked perish, כָּרִים כִּיקַר Psa 37:20 like the glory of the pastures (i.e. like gay, but short-lived, flowers). 4 (late and Aramaic) weighty, influential , מֵחָכְמָה יָקָר Eccl 10:1 weightier than wisdom and honour is a little folly. — In Prov 17:27 read Kt וְקַררֿוּחַ and one cool of spirit (see VB); in Zech 14:6 read וְקִמָּאוֺן וְקָרוֺת אוֺר יִהְיֶה לֹא there shall not be light but cold and congelation (see id. and Vrss.); **' but is very dubious; read probably וְקָרוֺת חוֺם there shall be neither heat nor cold , etc. (We and others). קִמָּאוֺן noun [masculine] congelation ; — Zech 14:6 Qr [ > Kt see √ Qal Imperfect ], so ᵑ6 ᵐ5 Symm We Now (with other change, but see GASm), see יָקָר . p 429
